positions.name: BranchLibraryCommuterHoursAdjustment
positions.frame: how should branch library opening hours be adjusted to accommodate commuter returns while maintaining flat staffing levels?
positions.why: Moira outlines opening early at eight on Tuesdays and Thursdays to facilitate commuter returns, and Teo complements this with an offsetting one-hour early closure to hold overall staffing hours constant.
